about_the_game:
Drunk or Baby – The Party Game That Makes You Guess Twice (Demo Version)

Is that chaotic behavior caused by a drunk adult… or a confused baby?
Welcome to Drunk or Baby, the hilarious party game where your powers of deduction—and your sense of humor—are put to the test.

In this demo version, you’ll experience the core gameplay that makes Drunk or Baby so fun, with dozens of bizarre real-life scenarios to guess from. Some features, like multiplayer mode, localization, and random rule modifiers, are not yet included in the demo but will be available in the full release.

How It Works

Each round, a scenario is shown to the players.
From “fell asleep in the dog bed” to “tried to eat a remote control”, you must guess: was it caused by a toddler or a tipsy adult?
Guess right, earn points, and see who truly understands chaotic behavior best.

You can play solo or pass-and-play with friends on one device. The game is fast, easy to learn, and guaranteed to get everyone laughing.

Demo Features

  • 🎉 Party Game Fun – 1–8 players, local pass-and-play on one device

  • 📜 50+ Real-Life Scenarios – Inspired by the wild things babies and drunk people actually do

  • 🗳 Vote-Based Gameplay – Make your choice, then see the results

  • ⏳ Time-Based Rounds – Keep the pace moving with built-in timers

  • 📱 Full Version Coming Soon – Multiplayer, localization, and random rule modifiers

Get ready to argue, laugh, and wonder how often the answer is both!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+, Windows 10, or later (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent DX10-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Local play requires keyboard/mouse or shared controller; Online requires stable network

short_description: A chaotic party game where 1-8 players guess whether bizarre real-life scenarios were caused by a drunk adult or a baby, using deduction, voting, and laughter to win.
